name: Death and the Thief of Stars
source:
The Stars have been stolen
                                                                                                                                                                           You are the god of death. The world is young, the night sky is blank, and the daytime is full of stars. 

Until the moon god lands on your mountain. He has stolen the stars from the day, and he plans to give them to the night. 

But the sun god is hunting the moon god. He says if the stars aren't returned, mortalkind will forever be doomed.

You are left wondering which god is worth your attention.
                                                                                                                                                                    Your choices will determine the fate of the night sky

[From [url=https://pgoldenglow.itch.io/death-and-the-thief-of-stars]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
星星被盗了
                                                                                                                                                                           你是死神。世界还年轻，夜空一片空白，白天繁星满天。

直到月神降临你的山上。他偷走了白天的星星，并打算把它们送给夜晚。

但太阳神正在猎杀月亮神。他说，如果星星不归还，凡人将永远灭亡。

你会想知道哪个神值得你关注。
                                                                                                                                                                    你的选择将决定夜空的命运

[来自[url=https://pgoldenglow.itch.io/death-and-the-thief-of-stars]Itch.io[/url]]
